correctness.rationale: The inward D4 quiver models ordered triples of subspaces as injective representations. Its classical finite-type classification has exactly eight 1-dimensional membership blocks and one 2-dimensional generic block, with no field parameter, including characteristic 2. Krull-Schmidt makes the multiplicity vector unique, so summing 8-part weak compositions over 2-dimensional block multiplicity gives N_d=sum_j C(d-2j+7,7), generating 1/((1-z)^8(1-z^2)), and leading d^8/(2*8!). The proposed intersection/sum quotient dimensions pick out the nine blocks. Independently computed d=0..9 coefficients [1,8,37,128,367,920,2083,4352,8518,15792]; finite coefficients do not prove arbitrary d or field, which rely on the classical D4 classification.
